messages:
sylvia: FYI PR #4477 is ready for docs review. Adds changelog entry for model-aurora deprecation, a short migration guide, updates python/js SDK snippets, and calls out kv-cache behavior. Need a content + examples pass before we schedule merge.
mike: tagging @priya @laura. I'll do a quick sanity check on links and CI preview. ETA ~1h.
priya: I'll take the snippets. Any param renames to watch for?
sylvia: Yes 1 response_mode -> output_mode in both SDKs. also note changed default kv-cache eviction for >65k tokens.
laura: wording nits: avoid "breaking" in public changelog. prefer "scheduled removal" + exact date. Add anchor to migrations page and link to it.
sylvia: good call, will update the blurb and add anchor.
ci-bot: Preview build for PR #4477 1 status: failed. Missing anchor 'migrations#model-aurora' and one broken internal link. See /artifacts/4477/log.txt
ben: I'll add the anchor and fix the link. also spotted python snippet indentation and an async example mismatch; pushing a tiny patch now.
ben: pushed fixes: added migration anchor, corrected internal link, adjusted python examples, and noted the SDK version with the rename. cc @priya
priya: thanks. I added a brief sentence about kv-cache eviction and a short note about backward-compatibility for small contexts. Snippets look good.
mike: re-running preview now.
ci-bot: Preview build for PR #4477 1 status: success. Diff summary: +1 migration anchor, +3 clarifying lines in migration guide, +5 snippet tweaks, -2 ambiguous phrases in changelog.
laura: content approved from me. One ask: include a parenthetical recommending quantization profile q4_0 for customers migrating to the lightweight replacement; helps guidance.
sylvia: added that parenthetical and referenced SDK v3.8.1 where the param rename lands.
mike: engineering review: validated variant compatibility and fallback behavior in staging. approved.
sylvia: proposed merge timing: hold until maintenance window on 2026-04-12 03:00 UTC, merge at 03:10 UTC and run a 15min canary. Any objections?
ben: no objections, will schedule canary monitors and alerting.
priya: fine from docs side.
laura: fine.
eng-bot: Scheduled merge for PR #4477 at 2026-04-12T03:10:00Z by request of @sylvia. Canary window: 2026-04-12T03:10:00Z - 2026-04-12T03:25:00Z.
sylvia: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
